description: Every floor plan of a rental building — name, beds, baths, square feet, rent range, lease term — and the units available under each, with unit number, price, square feet and move-in date. Compact drops photo and tour links; expand true keeps them.

buildingId.description: The building id from a rental search row (resultType propertyGroup).

expand.description: false (default): the compact form - the headline of a record or a search row, or the answer minus photo and tour links. true: the complete response from the data API (a full record is ~17 KB). Same price either way.

lat.description: Latitude, with lng, instead of buildingId.

lng.description: Longitude, with lat, instead of buildingId.

name: zillow_floor_plans
